visual: Lacy white blooms turn rose then deep pink · exceptionally compact · long flowering
water: Water regularly, especially in sun and containers; do not allow the rootball to dry out.
soil: Moist, well-drained; Sun needs reliably moist soil
prune: In spring cut last year's stems back to a pair of healthy buds.
cvs: This plant: 'Breg14' = (S)WITCH 'Ophelia' / POLESTAR · 'Little Lime' – compact green-white · 'Limelight' – larger lime-white panicles
resilience: Hardy and reliable; may get aphids, capsid bug, hydrangea scale, vine weevil, leaf spot, mildew or Botrytis.
uses: Patio containers · small gardens · front of borders · courtyards · cut flowers
toxicity: Plant material is harmful if eaten and may cause stomach upset; dogs and cats are at risk. Handling may trigger skin allergy, so wear gloves.
compliance: PBR protected: 'Breg14', CPVO EU52722; commercial propagation requires permission. UK plant passport rules apply to professional movement.
hardinessNote: Hardy in most places throughout the UK, approximately -15 to -10°C.
foliage: deciduous; broadly oval, coarsely toothed green leaves
